test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

I am not forced to study hard by my parents.

options.text: My parents do not force me to study hard.
My parents did not force me to study hard.
My parents are not forcing me to study hard.
My parents will not force me to study hard.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "I am not forced to study hard by my parents."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "my parents" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "am not forced" to "do not force" (present simple active).
 
• Ensure that the object "me" and the verb "to study hard" remain in the correct order.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"My parents do not force me to study hard."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"My parents did not force me to study hard." – This is in the past tense, not the present tense.
 
• **Option 3: **"My parents are not forcing me to study hard." – This is in the present continuous tense, not the present simple tense.
 
• **Option 4: **"My parents will not force me to study hard." – This is in the future tense, not the present tense.
